lines: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told Umar: if you can... ask this man to pray for you.
Uwais, from Yemen. He has a mother, and he is dutiful to her.
Years later, Umar, Razi Allah hu Anhu, asked every caravan from Yemen: Is Uwais among you? Until one day... yes.
The leader of the believers asked him: ask Allah to forgive me. And Uwais did.
Of all he could say, the Prophet, peace be upon him, mentioned his mother. Serve yours today.
Watch the full movie of Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam... link below.

beats.text: “If you can, ask *this man* to pray for you.”
beats.ur: اگر ہو سکے تو اس شخص سے اپنے لیے دعا کروانا

beats.text: *Uwais* from Yemen… he has a mother, and he is *dutiful to her*.
beats.ur: یمن کا اویس… اس کی ایک ماں ہے، اور وہ اس کا فرمانبردار ہے

beats.text: Umar (RA), to every caravan: *“Is Uwais among you?”* …Yes.
beats.ur: عمر رضی اللہ عنہ ہر قافلے سے: کیا تم میں اویس ہے؟ …ہاں

beats.text: The leader of the believers: *“Ask Allah to forgive me.”*
beats.ur: امیر المومنین نے کہا: میرے لیے مغفرت کی دعا کرو

beats.text: Of all he could say, the Prophet ﷺ mentioned *his mother*. Serve yours today.
beats.ur: نبی ﷺ نے اس کی ماں کا ذکر کیا۔ آج اپنی ماں کی خدمت کریں

beats.text: Watch the full movie of *Prophet Sulaiman (AS)*, link below.
beats.ur: حضرت سلیمان علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے
